```{r setup}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(plotly)
library(htmltools)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(DT)
library(targets)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(stringr)
library(dendsort)
```

```{r params}
padj_allvsall       <- 0.001
logfc_allvsall      <- 1
logfc_allvsall_high <- 3
rate_cutoff         <- 0.2
PADJ_ORA            <- 0.001
N_TOP_ORA           <- 10
PADJ_HET            <- 0.001
N_TOP_HET           <- 10
PADJ_THRESH         <- 0.05
N_TOP_SETS          <- 10
band_cols <- c("shared" = "#888888", "mCh⁺-biased" = "#56B4E9",
               "mCh−-biased" = "#E69F00")
```

```{r helpers}
plot_feature_expr <- function(df, genes, title = NULL) {
  df_genes <- dplyr::filter(df, gene %in% genes)
  p <- ggplot(df_genes, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, colour = expr)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.4, alpha = 0.6) +
    scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "magma", name = "expr") +
    facet_grid(gene ~ sample.name) +
    theme_void(base_size = 9) +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 7),
          legend.position = "right")
  if (!is.null(title)) p <- p + labs(title = title)
  p
}

COLLECTION_ABBREV <- c(
  "^HALLMARK_" = "HM_", "^KEGG_" = "KG_", "^REACTOME_" = "RE_",
  "^WP_" = "WP_", "^GOBP_" = "BP_"
)
abbreviate_pathway <- function(x) {
  for (pat in names(COLLECTION_ABBREV)) x <- sub(pat, COLLECTION_ABBREV[[pat]], x)
  x
}

hclust_ord <- function(mat) {
  if (nrow(mat) < 2) return(rownames(mat))
  rownames(mat)[dendsort::dendsort(hclust(dist(mat), method = "ward.D2"))$order]
}

scatter_theme <- theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "right",
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.2),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

scatter_guides <- guides(
  fill = guide_legend(
    override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 4, shape = 21, colour = "white")
  ),
  size = guide_legend(
    override.aes = list(alpha = 1, fill = "grey50", colour = "white", shape = 21),
    range        = c(2, 8)
  )
)

top_n_combined <- function(df, n_origin = 20, n_diag = 20) {
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      quadrant  = paste0(if_else(log_fc_neg >= 0, "R", "L"),
                         if_else(log_fc_pos >= 0, "U", "D")),
      dist      = sqrt(log_fc_neg^2 + log_fc_pos^2),
      diag_dist = abs(log_fc_pos - log_fc_neg) / sqrt(2)
    )
  by_origin <- df %>% group_by(quadrant) %>% slice_max(dist,      n = n_origin) %>% ungroup()
  by_diag   <- df %>% group_by(quadrant) %>% slice_max(diag_dist, n = n_diag)   %>% ungroup()
  bind_rows(by_origin, by_diag) %>% distinct(feature, cluster, quadrant, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

repel_combined <- function(df_label, inf = 30) {
  quad_limits <- list(
    RU = list(xlim = c(0,    inf), ylim = c(0,   inf)),
    RD = list(xlim = c(0,    inf), ylim = c(-inf, 0)),
    LU = list(xlim = c(-inf, 0),   ylim = c(0,   inf)),
    LD = list(xlim = c(-inf, 0),   ylim = c(-inf, 0))
  )
  lapply(names(quad_limits), function(q) {
    d <- filter(df_label, quadrant == q)
    if (nrow(d) == 0) return(NULL)
    lims <- quad_limits[[q]]
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data           = d,
      aes(label = feature, colour = cluster),
      size           = 2.3, max.overlaps = 30, show.legend = FALSE,
      segment.size   = 0.2,
      segment.colour = scales::alpha("grey", alpha = 0.6),
      xlim           = lims$xlim,
      ylim           = lims$ylim
    )
  })
}

make_volcano <- function(df, comparison_label) {
  df |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      neg_log_p  = -log10(pmax(padj, 1e-30)),
      sig        = (padj <= padj_allvsall & log_fc >=  logfc_allvsall & rate1 >= rate_cutoff) |
                   (padj <= padj_allvsall & log_fc <= -logfc_allvsall & rate2 >= rate_cutoff),
      max_rate   = pmax(rate1, rate2),
      comparison = comparison_label
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!feature %in% c(sex_degs, "ENSMUSG00000121395"))
}

make_het_bubble <- function(df_ora, paths, dir_label) {
  df_dir <- df_ora %>%
    dplyr::filter(reg_dir == dir_label, pathway %in% paths)
  if (nrow(df_dir) == 0) return(patchwork::plot_spacer())

  fe_mat <- df_dir %>%
    dplyr::select(pathway, cluster, fold_enrichment) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = cluster, values_from = fold_enrichment,
                       values_fill = 0, values_fn = mean) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("pathway") %>%
    as.matrix()
  fe_mat[!is.finite(fe_mat)] <- 0

  row_ord <- hclust_ord(fe_mat)
  col_ord <- hclust_ord(t(fe_mat))

  df_dir <- df_dir %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      pathway = factor(pathway, levels = row_ord),
      cluster = factor(cluster, levels = col_ord)
    )

  fill_colours <- if (dir_label == "up") c("white", "#fc8d59", "#d73027") else c("white", "#87ceeb", "#2166ac")
  ggplot(df_dir, aes(x = cluster, y = pathway)) +
    geom_point(data = ~dplyr::filter(.x, !sig),
               aes(size = overlap_ratio),
               shape = 21, fill = "grey88", colour = "white", stroke = 0.3, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_point(data = ~dplyr::filter(.x, sig),
               aes(size = overlap_ratio, fill = fold_enrichment),
               colour = "black", shape = 21, stroke = 0.3, alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colours = fill_colours,
                         na.value = "grey90", name = "log2 fold\nenrichment") +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Overlap\nratio", range = c(1, 7)) +
    labs(x = "Cluster", y = NULL,
         subtitle = paste0(df_ora$comparison[1], " — ",
                           if (dir_label == "up") "Up-regulated" else "Down-regulated"),
         caption  = "Filled: sig | Colour: log2 fold enrichment | Size: overlap/pathway size") +
    scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
    theme(axis.text.x    = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 0),
          axis.text.y    = element_text(size = 7),
          panel.grid     = element_line(colour = "grey93"),
          plot.subtitle  = element_text(face = "bold"),
          legend.position = "right")
}
```

# Cluster marker ORA

ORA on per-cluster marker genesets derived from `cluster_markers_res_lst_hsc` (genes consistently up in a cluster across all pairwise comparisons).

```{r clust-markers-data}
targets::tar_load(cluster_markers_res_lst_hsc)

feat_delegate_summary <- cluster_markers_res_lst_hsc$sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9 %>%
  mutate(sig = log_fc >= 1 & padj <= 1e-5) %>%
  group_by(feature, group1) %>%
  summarize(rate1 = unique(rate1),
            rate2_median = median(rate2),
            rate2_max = max(rate2),
            group1_is_max = rate1 > rate2_max,
            n = dplyr::n(),
            n_sig = sum(sig),
            sig_groups = paste0(unique(group2[sig]), collapse = ","),
            notsig_groups = paste0(unique(group2[!sig]), collapse = ","),
            prop = n_sig / n,
            median_padj = median(padj),
            median_logfc = median(log_fc),
            min_padj = min(padj),
            max_logfc = max(log_fc)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(-(median_logfc * rate1 / rate2_median))
rm(cluster_markers_res_lst_hsc)
```

```{r clust-markers-lst}
clust_marker_lst <- feat_delegate_summary %>%
  filter(prop >= 0.6 & max_logfc >= 1 & min_padj < 1e-5) %>%
  with(split(feature, group1))
```

```{r clust-markers-universe}
srt_tmp <- targets::tar_read(mpn_processed_data_hsc)
clust_marker_ora_universe <- rownames(srt_tmp)
rm(srt_tmp); gc()
```

```{r clust-markers-ora-run}
clust_marker_ora_list <- compute_ora_results(
  genesets = clust_marker_lst,
  universe = clust_marker_ora_universe,
  min_size = 20
)
```

```{r clust-markers-ora-bubble}
ora_all_clust <- dplyr::bind_rows(clust_marker_ora_list)

top_paths_clust <- ora_all_clust %>%
  dplyr::filter(padj < PADJ_ORA) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(foldEnrichment = ifelse(is.infinite(foldEnrichment),
                                        max(foldEnrichment[is.finite(foldEnrichment)], na.rm = TRUE),
                                        foldEnrichment)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(geneset) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(foldEnrichment, n = N_TOP_ORA, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::pull(pathway) %>%
  unique()
```

```{r clust-markers-ora-bubble-plot}
#| fig.height: !expr min(10, max(3, 0.22 * length(top_paths_clust) + 1.2))
#| fig.width: !expr min(14, max(5, 0.9 * length(clust_marker_ora_list) + 2.5))
if (length(top_paths_clust) > 0) {
  bubble_df_clust <- ora_all_clust %>%
    dplyr::filter(pathway %in% top_paths_clust) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      pathway         = stringr::str_trunc(abbreviate_pathway(pathway), 55),
      fold_enrichment = log2(foldEnrichment),
      overlap_ratio   = overlap / size,
      sig             = padj < PADJ_ORA
    )

  fe_mat <- bubble_df_clust %>%
    dplyr::select(pathway, geneset, fold_enrichment) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = geneset, values_from = fold_enrichment,
                       values_fill = 0, values_fn = mean) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("pathway") %>%
    as.matrix()
  fe_mat[!is.finite(fe_mat)] <- 0

  row_ord <- hclust_ord(fe_mat)
  col_ord <- hclust_ord(t(fe_mat))

  ggplot(bubble_df_clust,
         aes(x = factor(geneset, levels = col_ord),
             y = factor(pathway,  levels = row_ord))) +
    geom_point(data = ~dplyr::filter(.x, !sig),
               aes(size = overlap_ratio),
               shape = 21, fill = "grey88", colour = "white", stroke = 0.3, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_point(data = ~dplyr::filter(.x, sig),
               aes(size = overlap_ratio, fill = fold_enrichment),
               colour = "black", shape = 21, stroke = 0.3, alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("white", "#fc8d59", "#d73027"),
                         na.value = "grey90", name = "log2 fold\nenrichment") +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Overlap\nratio", range = c(1, 8)) +
    labs(x = "Cluster", y = NULL,
         title   = "HSC cluster markers — ORA bubble plot",
         caption = "Filled: padj < 0.05  |  Grey: not significant  |  Colour: log2 fold enrichment  |  Size: overlap/pathway size\nRows and columns ordered by Ward hierarchical clustering of log2 fold enrichment") +
    scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 0),
          axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 7),
          panel.grid   = element_line(colour = "grey93"),
          legend.position = "right")
} else {
  message("No significant pathways found for any cluster marker geneset.")
}
```

# Het vs all ORA

::: {.panel-tabset}

## HSC

```{r allvsall-hsc-gsea-data}
hsc_clust_level <- "res_0.9"
tar_load(delegate_pairwise_markers_hsc)
tar_load(sex_degs)
hsc_raw <- delegate_pairwise_markers_hsc[[hsc_clust_level]]
rm(delegate_pairwise_markers_hsc)

volcano_neg <- make_volcano(hsc_raw$mch_neg_vs_wt, "Het mCh− vs WT")
volcano_pos <- make_volcano(hsc_raw$mch_pos_vs_wt, "Het mCh⁺ vs WT")
volcano_df  <- bind_rows(volcano_neg, volcano_pos)
rm(hsc_raw, volcano_neg, volcano_pos)
```

### Het mCh geneset ORA {.unnumbered}

All pairwise comparisons between sample groups per cluster (WT vs HET+, WT vs HET-, HET+ vs HET-) via `DElegate::findDE(..., compare = "all_vs_all")`.

```{r het-clust-geneset}
# Gene lists per cluster × comparison × direction — used for ORA below
het_clust_genesets <- volcano_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(!cluster %in% c("12", "15", "16", "17", "13", "11", "10", "8"),
                abs(log_fc) >= 0.2 & padj < 1e-2) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(reg_dir = ifelse(log_fc >= 0, "up", "down")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cluster, comparison, reg_dir) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(genes = list(unique(feature)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(gs_name = paste(cluster, comparison, reg_dir, sep = "|||"))

het_clust_gs_list <- setNames(het_clust_genesets$genes, het_clust_genesets$gs_name)
```

```{r het-clust-ora-run}
het_clust_ora_list <- compute_ora_results(
  genesets = het_clust_gs_list,
  universe = clust_marker_ora_universe,
  min_size = 20
)
```

```{r het-clust-ora-prep}
het_clust_ora_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(het_clust_ora_list) %>%
  tidyr::separate(geneset, into = c("cluster", "comparison", "reg_dir"), sep = "\\|\\|\\|") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    pathway         = stringr::str_trunc(abbreviate_pathway(pathway), 55),
    fe_finite       = ifelse(is.infinite(foldEnrichment),
                             max(foldEnrichment[is.finite(foldEnrichment)], na.rm = TRUE),
                             foldEnrichment),
    fold_enrichment = log2(fe_finite),
    overlap_ratio   = overlap / size,
    sig             = padj < PADJ_HET
  )

# Top N pathways per cluster × comparison × direction, then take the union.
# This ensures every cluster contributes equally to the displayed pathway set.
top_paths_het <- het_clust_ora_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(padj < PADJ_HET, is.finite(fold_enrichment)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cluster, comparison, reg_dir) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(fold_enrichment, n = N_TOP_HET, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::distinct(comparison, reg_dir, pathway)
```

```{r het-clust-ora-plot, results="asis", fig.width=14}
#| fig.height: !expr 0.35 * N_TOP_HET + 2.5

for (comp in unique(top_paths_het$comparison)) {
  cat("####", comp, "{.unnumbered}\n\n")

  paths_up   <- top_paths_het %>%
    dplyr::filter(comparison == comp, reg_dir == "up") %>%
    dplyr::pull(pathway)
  paths_down <- top_paths_het %>%
    dplyr::filter(comparison == comp, reg_dir == "down") %>%
    dplyr::pull(pathway)

  df_comp <- dplyr::filter(het_clust_ora_df, comparison == comp)

  p_up   <- make_het_bubble(df_comp, paths_up,   "up")
  p_down <- make_het_bubble(df_comp, paths_down, "down")

  print(patchwork::wrap_plots(p_up, p_down, nrow = 1, guides = "collect"))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

### Geneset definition {.unnumbered}

Genes with |log FC| ≥ 1 in at least one comparison are split into three groups per quadrant based on their position relative to the diagonal band (y = x ± 1):

- **shared**: between the diagonal lines — similar effect in both mCh− and mCh+
- **mCh⁺-biased**: above the upper diagonal (y = x + 1) — stronger in mCh+
- **mCh⁻-biased**: below the lower diagonal (y = x − 1) — stronger in mCh−

```{r allvsall-hsc-gsea-scatter-prep}
tar_load(scatter_df_hsc)
tar_load(genesets_hsc)
scatter_df      <- scatter_df_hsc[[hsc_clust_level]]
hsc_genesets_df <- genesets_hsc$genesets_df
hsc_genesets    <- genesets_hsc$genesets
rm(scatter_df_hsc, genesets_hsc)
```

```{r allvsall-hsc-geneset-scatter, fig.height=9, fig.width=9}
df_label_gs <- hsc_genesets_df %>%
  group_by(geneset) %>%
  slice_max(sqrt(log_fc_neg^2 + log_fc_pos^2), n = 8) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(mapping = aes(x = log_fc_neg, y = log_fc_pos)) +
  geom_point(data = scatter_df, aes(size = max_rate),
             fill = "grey88", colour = "white", shape = 21, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept =  0, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.55,
              linetype = "solid") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept =  1, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4,
              linetype = "22") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = -1, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4,
              linetype = "22") +
  geom_point(data = hsc_genesets_df, aes(fill = band, size = max_rate),
             colour = "white", shape = 21, alpha = 0.7) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data         = df_label_gs,
    aes(label    = feature, colour = band),
    size         = 2.3, max.overlaps = 30, show.legend = FALSE,
    segment.size = 0.2,
    segment.colour = scales::alpha("grey", alpha = 0.6),
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = band_cols, name = "Gene group") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = band_cols, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.2)) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Max expression\nrate", range = c(0.5, 4)) +
  facet_wrap(~quadrant) +
  labs(x = "log FC  (Het mCh− vs WT)", y = "log FC  (Het mCh⁺ vs WT)",
       title = "CD41⁺ HSC — geneset membership",
       caption = "Grey: all significant genes  |  Coloured: |log FC| ≥ 1  |  Bands: y = x ± 1") +
  scatter_theme + scatter_guides
```

### Geneset over-representation analysis {.unnumbered}

For each defined geneset, over-representation of MSigDB pathways (Hallmark, KEGG, Reactome, WikiPathways, GO:BP) is tested with `fgsea::fora()` (Fisher's exact test). The background is the union of all significant genes in the scatter, held constant across all geneset tests.

```{r allvsall-hsc-ora-setup}
tar_load(ora_results_hsc)
hsc_ora_list <- ora_results_hsc
rm(ora_results_hsc)
```

#### Significant pathways per geneset {.unnumbered}

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r allvsall-hsc-ora-table, results="asis"}
for (gs_name in names(hsc_ora_list)) {
  cat("##", gs_name, "\n\n")
  sig <- hsc_ora_list[[gs_name]] %>%
    filter(padj < PADJ_THRESH) %>%
    arrange(desc(foldEnrichment)) %>%
    mutate(pathway          = abbreviate_pathway(pathway),
           foldEnrichment   = round(foldEnrichment, 2),
           overlap          = paste0(overlap, "/", size),
           padj             = signif(padj, 3)) %>%
    select(pathway, foldEnrichment, padj, overlap)
  if (nrow(sig) == 0) { cat("No significant pathways.\n\n"); next }
  print(htmltools::tagList(
    DT::datatable(sig, rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
                  options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE))
  ))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

:::

#### ORA bubble plot — top pathways {.unnumbered}

```{r allvsall-hsc-ora-bubble}
ora_all_hsc <- bind_rows(hsc_ora_list)
top_paths_hsc <- filter(ora_all_hsc, padj < PADJ_THRESH) %>%
  group_by(geneset) %>%
  slice_min(padj, n = N_TOP_SETS) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pull(pathway) %>%
  unique()
```

```{r allvsall-hsc-ora-bubble-plot}
#| fig.height: !expr min(7.5, max(3, 0.22 * length(top_paths_hsc) + 1.2))
#| fig.width: !expr min(8.5, max(4, 1.1 * length(hsc_ora_list) + 2.5))
if (length(top_paths_hsc) > 0) {
  bubble_df_hsc <- ora_all_hsc %>%
    filter(pathway %in% top_paths_hsc) %>%
    mutate(
      pathway         = stringr::str_trunc(abbreviate_pathway(pathway), 55),
      fold_enrichment = log2(foldEnrichment),
      overlap_ratio   = overlap / size,
      sig             = padj < PADJ_THRESH
    )

  pathway_order_hsc <- ora_all_hsc %>%
    filter(pathway %in% top_paths_hsc) %>%
    mutate(pathway = stringr::str_trunc(abbreviate_pathway(pathway), 55)) %>%
    group_by(pathway) %>%
    summarise(min_padj = min(padj, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    arrange(min_padj) %>%
    pull(pathway)

  ggplot(bubble_df_hsc,
         aes(x = geneset, y = factor(pathway, levels = rev(pathway_order_hsc)))) +
    geom_point(data = ~filter(.x, !sig),
               aes(size = overlap_ratio),
               shape = 21, fill = "grey88", colour = "white", stroke = 0.3, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_point(data = ~filter(.x, sig),
               aes(size = overlap_ratio, fill = fold_enrichment),
               colour = "black", shape = 21, stroke = 0.3, alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("white", "#fc8d59", "#d73027"),
                         na.value = "grey90", name = "log2 fold\nenrichment") +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Overlap\nratio", range = c(1, 8)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
         title    = "HSC genesets — ORA bubble plot",
         caption  = "Filled: padj < 0.05  |  Grey: not significant  |  Colour: log2 fold enrichment  |  Size: overlap/pathway size") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
    theme(axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 0),
          axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 7),
          panel.grid   = element_line(colour = "grey93"),
          legend.position = "right")
} else {
  message("No significant pathways found across HSC genesets.")
}
```

## MNC

```{r allvsall-mnc-gsea-data}
tar_load(scatter_df_mnc)
tar_load(genesets_mnc)
mnc_genesets_df <- genesets_mnc$genesets_df
mnc_genesets    <- genesets_mnc$genesets
rm(genesets_mnc)
```

### Geneset definition {.unnumbered}

Same band logic as HSC: genes with |log FC| ≥ 1 in at least one comparison, split by position relative to y = x ± 1.

```{r allvsall-mnc-geneset-scatter, fig.height=9, fig.width=9}
df_label_gs_mnc <- mnc_genesets_df %>%
  group_by(geneset) %>%
  slice_max(sqrt(log_fc_neg^2 + log_fc_pos^2), n = 8) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(mapping = aes(x = log_fc_neg, y = log_fc_pos)) +
  geom_point(data = scatter_df_mnc, aes(size = max_rate),
             fill = "grey88", colour = "white", shape = 21, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept =  0, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.55,
              linetype = "solid") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept =  1, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4,
              linetype = "22") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = -1, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4,
              linetype = "22") +
  geom_point(data = mnc_genesets_df, aes(fill = band, size = max_rate),
             colour = "white", shape = 21, alpha = 0.7) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data         = df_label_gs_mnc,
    aes(label    = feature, colour = band),
    size         = 2.3, max.overlaps = 30, show.legend = FALSE,
    segment.size = logfc_allvsall, segment.colour = "grey60"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = band_cols, name = "Gene group") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = band_cols, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.2)) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Max expression\nrate", range = c(0.5, 4)) +
  facet_wrap(~quadrant) +
  labs(x = "log FC  (mCh− vs WT)", y = "log FC  (mCh⁺ vs WT)",
       title = "MNC — geneset membership",
       caption = "Grey: all significant genes  |  Coloured: |log FC| ≥ 1  |  Bands: y = x ± 1") +
  scatter_theme + scatter_guides
```

```{r allvsall-mnc-geneset-summary-table}
mnc_genesets_df %>%
  group_by(geneset, quadrant, band) %>%
  summarise(n_genes = n_distinct(feature), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(quadrant, band) %>%
  DT::datatable(
    caption  = "MNC genesets — summary",
    rownames = FALSE,
    filter   = "top",
    options  = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r allvsall-mnc-geneset-membership-table}
mnc_genesets_df %>%
  arrange(geneset, feature) %>%
  select(geneset, quadrant, band, feature) %>%
  DT::datatable(
    caption  = "MNC geneset membership — genes with |log FC| ≥ 1 in at least one comparison",
    rownames = FALSE,
    filter   = "top",
    options  = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE)
  )
```

### Geneset over-representation analysis {.unnumbered}

```{r allvsall-mnc-ora-run}
tar_load(ora_results_mnc)
mnc_ora_list <- ora_results_mnc
rm(ora_results_mnc)
```

#### Significant pathways per geneset {.unnumbered}

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r allvsall-mnc-ora-table, results="asis"}
for (gs_name in names(mnc_ora_list)) {
  cat("##", gs_name, "\n\n")
  sig <- mnc_ora_list[[gs_name]] %>%
    filter(padj < PADJ_THRESH) %>%
    arrange(desc(foldEnrichment)) %>%
    mutate(pathway          = abbreviate_pathway(pathway),
           foldEnrichment   = round(foldEnrichment, 2),
           overlap          = paste0(overlap, "/", size),
           padj             = signif(padj, 3)) %>%
    select(pathway, foldEnrichment, padj, overlap)
  if (nrow(sig) == 0) { cat("No significant pathways.\n\n"); next }
  print(htmltools::tagList(
    DT::datatable(sig, rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
                  options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE))
  ))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

:::

#### ORA bubble plot — top pathways {.unnumbered}

```{r allvsall-mnc-ora-bubble}
ora_all_mnc <- bind_rows(mnc_ora_list)
top_paths_mnc <- filter(ora_all_mnc, padj < PADJ_THRESH) %>%
  group_by(geneset) %>%
  slice_min(padj, n = N_TOP_SETS) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pull(pathway) %>%
  unique()
```

```{r allvsall-mnc-ora-bubble-plot}
#| fig.height: !expr min(7.5, max(3, 0.22 * length(top_paths_mnc) + 1.2))
#| fig.width: !expr min(8.5, max(4, 1.1 * length(mnc_ora_list) + 2.5))
if (length(top_paths_mnc) > 0) {
  bubble_df_mnc <- ora_all_mnc %>%
    filter(pathway %in% top_paths_mnc) %>%
    mutate(
      pathway         = stringr::str_trunc(abbreviate_pathway(pathway), 55),
      fold_enrichment = log2(foldEnrichment),
      overlap_ratio   = overlap / size,
      sig             = padj < PADJ_THRESH
    )

  pathway_order_mnc <- ora_all_mnc %>%
    filter(pathway %in% top_paths_mnc) %>%
    mutate(pathway = stringr::str_trunc(abbreviate_pathway(pathway), 55)) %>%
    group_by(pathway) %>%
    summarise(min_padj = min(padj, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    arrange(min_padj) %>%
    pull(pathway)

  ggplot(bubble_df_mnc,
         aes(x = geneset, y = factor(pathway, levels = rev(pathway_order_mnc)))) +
    geom_point(data = ~filter(.x, !sig),
               aes(size = overlap_ratio),
               shape = 21, fill = "grey88", colour = "white", stroke = 0.3, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_point(data = ~filter(.x, sig),
               aes(size = overlap_ratio, fill = fold_enrichment),
               colour = "black", shape = 21, stroke = 0.3, alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("white", "#fc8d59", "#d73027"),
                         na.value = "grey90", name = "log2 fold\nenrichment") +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Overlap\nratio", range = c(1, 8)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
         title    = "MNC genesets — ORA bubble plot",
         caption  = "Filled: padj < 0.05  |  Grey: not significant  |  Colour: log2 fold enrichment  |  Size: overlap/pathway size") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
    theme(axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 0),
          axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 7),
          panel.grid   = element_line(colour = "grey93"),
          legend.position = "right")
} else {
  message("No significant pathways found across MNC genesets.")
}
```

### Module score on UMAP {.unnumbered}

```{r allvsall-mnc-module-score, eval=FALSE}
#| fig.height: !expr 4 * length(mnc_genesets)
#| fig.width: 16
tar_load(module_scores_mnc)
score_features_mnc <- colnames(module_scores_mnc)[1]
ms_long_mnc <- tidyr::pivot_longer(module_scores_mnc,
                                   cols      = dplyr::all_of(score_features_mnc),
                                   names_to  = "gene",
                                   values_to = "expr")
plot_feature_expr(ms_long_mnc, genes = score_features_mnc, title = "MNC — module scores")
rm(module_scores_mnc, ms_long_mnc); gc()
```

```{r allvsall-mnc-biased-expr-plot, fig.height=30, fig.width=16, eval=FALSE}
tar_load(biased_feature_expr_mnc)
for (gs_name in unique(biased_feature_expr_mnc$geneset)) {
  feats <- unique(biased_feature_expr_mnc$gene[biased_feature_expr_mnc$geneset == gs_name])
  p <- plot_feature_expr(biased_feature_expr_mnc, genes = feats) +
    patchwork::plot_annotation(title = gs_name,
                               theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold")))
  print(p)
}
rm(biased_feature_expr_mnc); gc()
```

```{r allvsall-mnc-gsea-cleanup, eval=FALSE}
rm(scatter_df_mnc, mnc_genesets_df, mnc_genesets, mnc_ora_list, ora_all_mnc); gc()
```

## Stroma

```{r allvsall-stroma-gsea-data}
tar_load(genesets_stroma)
stroma_genesets_df <- genesets_stroma$genesets_df
stroma_genesets    <- genesets_stroma$genesets
rm(genesets_stroma)
```

### Geneset definition {.unnumbered}

Stroma has a single comparison (Het vs WT), so genesets are defined by direction and effect size: up- and down-regulated genes with |log FC| ≥ 1.

```{r allvsall-stroma-geneset-summary-table}
stroma_genesets_df %>%
  group_by(geneset) %>%
  summarise(n_genes = n_distinct(feature), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(geneset) %>%
  DT::datatable(
    caption  = "Stroma genesets — summary",
    rownames = FALSE,
    filter   = "top",
    options  = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r allvsall-stroma-geneset-membership-table}
stroma_genesets_df %>%
  arrange(geneset, feature) %>%
  select(geneset, feature) %>%
  DT::datatable(
    caption  = "Stroma geneset membership — significant genes with |log FC| ≥ 1 (Het vs WT)",
    rownames = FALSE,
    filter   = "top",
    options  = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE)
  )
```

### Geneset over-representation analysis {.unnumbered}

